text: Standard or specified longitudinal drive cycle, 1 input, 4 outputs, {Drive cycle source} sets Select the drive cycle source; {From workspace} sets the workspace variable, {Drive cycle source file} sets the file name .mat,.xls,.xlsx or.txt, {Repeat cyclically} sets the repeat drive cycle, {Output acceleration} sets the output the acceleration, {Output gear shift data} sets the output the gear, {Start time, t_wot1} sets the drive cycle start time, {Initial reference speed, xdot_woto} sets the speed, {Nominal reference speed, xdot_wot1} sets the speed, {Time to start deceleration, t_wot2} sets the time, {Final reference speed, xdot_wot2} sets the speed, {WOT simulation time, t_wotend} sets the time duration of simulation, {Source velocity units} sets the velocity units, {Output velocity units} sets the velocity units, {Output acceleration units} sets the acceleration units, {Output sample period (0 for continuous), dt} sets the period between samples, {Enable fault tracking}, {Speed tolerance, velBnd} sets the drive cycle speed tolerance, {Speed tolerance units, velBndUnit} sets the units, {Velocity feedback units, inUnit} sets the velocity feedback, {Time tolerance, timeBnd}, {Enable Failure Tracking}, {Stop simulation when trace fails}, {Maximum number of faults, maxFaultCnt} sets the maximum number of faults allowed, {Maximum single fault time, maxFaultTime} sets the maximum allowed duration of single fault, {Maximum total fault time, maxTotFaultTime}, {Display simulation trace} displays velocity trace, {Simulation trace update rate, dtTrace} sets the trace update period and {Simulation trace display window, traceWindow} sets the trace window update rate. Values come from the instance.
